SOLANKI SATISH Mumbai, India Mobile: 7400414730 | Email: solasat0803@gmail.com

PROJECT MANAGER – CAPITAL MARKETS / AML / TRADE TRANSFORMATION

EXECUTIVE PROFILE Transformation and Financial Services professional with extensive experience in Project

and Program Management across global financial institutions. Proven Project Manager with strong delivery

ownership across Capital Markets, Trade Operations, Collateral Management, AML, Risk, Compliance, and

Regulatory Transformation programs. Result-oriented leader with strong stakeholder management,

governance, and execution capabilities across multi-year, multi-geography initiatives involving business

transformation, digitization, automation, and large-scale system implementations.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Program Manager / Project Manager – ICM Transformation Optimum InfoSystem Private Limited –

Client: CitiBank NA | Mumbai Jul 2024 – Present

Project: ICM (Institutional Credit Management) Transformation – Capital Markets / Trade & Collateral

Management

Responsible for end-to-end Project and Program Management of complex, large-scale Capital Market and

Trade-related transformation initiatives. Leading delivery of multi-year strategic programs focused on credit

risk, collateral management, trade exposure, regulatory compliance, and governance.

Key Responsibilities: • Lead and manage multiple projects as Project Manager within the ICM

Transformation portfolio across Capital Markets and Trade domains. • Own project planning, execution,

governance, reporting, risk and issue management, and stakeholder communication. • Drive delivery of

Trade, Collateral Management, Exposure, and Risk solutions within regulatory and compliance frameworks.

Manage AML, risk control, and regulatory readiness requirements in coordination with business,

technology, and compliance teams. • Lead Data Foundation and Digitization initiatives including NLP-driven

CSA digitalization for trade and collateral agreements. • Manage integration of trade, market, and exposure

data feeds for unified exposure and MTM calculations. • Oversee reconciliation, rules engine development,

and automation initiatives supporting trade and collateral operations. • Act as key liaison with senior

stakeholders, program directors, and governance forums ensuring timely and compliant delivery.

Senior Program Manager – Digital Transformation CareerNet Technologies – Client: Willis Towers Watson

(WTW) | Mumbai May 2023 – Jun 2024

Project: Global Digital Transformation (Insurance, Governance & Operations)

Functioned as Project Manager for multiple digital transformation initiatives across governance,

operations, and regulatory frameworks. • Owned project plans, backlogs, delivery timelines, dependencies,

and stakeholder communication. • Led global governance forums, steering committees, and cross-

functional delivery teams.

Project Manager – Digital Transformation (AVP) Capco Technologies – Client: HSBC Bank | Mumbai Feb 2022

May 2023

1

Project: Capital Markets, Trade, Payments & Collateral Automation

Worked as Project Manager for Capital Market, Trade Operations, Payments, and Collateral Management

automation initiatives. • Delivered transformation programs aligned to AML, risk controls, operational

efficiency, and regulatory compliance. • Led RPA and process re-engineering initiatives improving trade

processing accuracy and controls.

Project Manager NSEIT | Mumbai Mar 2021 – Feb 2022

Project: Capital Markets & Banking Transformation (Indian Bank, IDFC First Bank)

Managed finance, trade, and integration projects involving middleware implementation and RPA-driven

automation. • Owned end-to-end project delivery including scope, timelines, governance, client

management, and risk mitigation.

Earlier Experience Senior Associate – Financial Accounting & Reporting | BNP Paribas Senior Manager –

Finance (Controllers Group) | TransFast (Mastercard Company) Senior Project Consultant – SOX Audit &

Internal Controls | RGP Process Supervisor – Trade Support & Capital Markets Operations | Deutsche Bank

Senior Team Member – Controls & Risk Management | JP Morgan Chase

SKILLS Project Management | Program Management | Capital Markets | Trade Operations | AML &

Compliance | Risk & Regulatory Change | Collateral Management | Payments & Settlements | Governance

& Controls | Stakeholder Management | Digital & Automation Transformation

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS MBA – Accounting & Finance | Symbiosis International University Bachelor

of Commerce | Mumbai University Lean Six Sigma Green Belt | VarSigma PMP – Trained | Risk

Management in Financial Sector | GST Practitioner

REWARDS & RECOGNITION Recipient of multiple Individual and Team Awards for excellence in Project

Delivery, Controls, SOX Audit, and Process Improvement

(Satish Solanki)
